value.rationale: Geometric fixed-point filtration is a natural but distinct equivariant object used in Smith-type arguments; its full shape cannot be deduced merely by extracting invariant subspaces of ambient homology. An all-dimension and all-scale PL reduction determines this filtration exactly and transfers a genuine mixed-dimensional sphere-wedge homotopy classification to an as-yet underdetermined ambient scale-four regime. The scale-four corollary is a meaningful infinite family, not an arbitrary numeric slice, while the argument is explicit and reusable.
